questions.q: How is young Matt Murdock blinded?
options: A boxing match injury to his eyes
questions.why: A radioactive substance falling from a truck blinds Matt while he saves a man, and heightens his other senses.

questions.q: Which New York neighborhood is Matt Murdock's home turf?
questions.why: Matt is from Hell's Kitchen, a working-class Manhattan neighborhood.

questions.q: Which crime lord becomes Daredevil's primary nemesis during Frank Miller's run?
questions.why: Kingpin became Daredevil's chief nemesis in Miller's run.
Writer Stan Lee and artist Bill Everett launched Daredevil #1 in April 1964.

questions.q: Which hitman murders Elektra in the comics?
questions.why: Bullseye kills Elektra, one of Daredevil's best-known tragedies.

questions.q: Which storyline (issues #226-233) has Karen Page sell his secret identity and reveals Matt's mother is a nun?
questions.why: In Born Again Matt is ruined by Kingpin, and learns his mother Maggie is a nun.

questions.q: In which issue did Elektra Natchios first appear?
questions.why: Frank Miller introduced Elektra in Daredevil #168 (January 1981).

questions.q: Which artist introduced Daredevil's all-red costume in issue #7?
questions.why: Wally Wood replaced the original yellow-and-black costume with the red one.

questions.q: In which year did Frank Miller's initial run on Daredevil begin?
questions.why: Miller's first stint on the title began in May 1979 and wrapped up in February 1983.

questions.q: What is the name of the law firm Matt runs with his college roommate Foggy?
questions.why: Foggy Nelson is Matt's best friend and law partner in Nelson and Murdock.
